title: rubus exaltatus var. nitidus
intro: Rubus exaltatus var. nitidus, commonly known as the Blackberry of Taiwan, is a type of bramble plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and research has shown that it has various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rubus exaltatus var. nitidus include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting anticancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
